text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: "Dear Yuki, I wanted to try something different from calling you or messaging you on LANE, so I decided to write you a letter!"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: "My badge test is coming up soon! Actually, it's on the same day as one of your big races."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: "I'll be too old next year, so this is my last chance to compete in an international tournament and fulfill my dream. To be honest, I'm really scared."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: "What if I don't land a jump correctly? Just like that, all of the hard work I've put in will be for nothing… Then what will I do?"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: "But just when I thought about quitting for good, I remembered you have a big race that same day."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: "There's no way I can let myself give up knowing that you're out there working so hard. So let's both do our best!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "And then, we'll be one step closer to our dreams."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, ready or not… here I come.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup is about to begin, and the stands are brimming with a strange energy.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I'm so excited! We get to see the Snow Angel take on the Beauty of the Century!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Don't call them that! Their names are Yukino Bijin and Gold City!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: And they're gonna show us an awesome race!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fans A and B
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hi, City.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Let's run our hearts out today.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Let's run like we've never run before—run in a way that, when we cross that finish line… we love who we've become.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You don't gotta tell me twice!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Let's go, City. Our race is about t'begin!
